build_task_with_define_task_decorator: use the define_task decorator to register a new PHYRE physics puzzle task
create_dynamic_jar_with_C_add: create a dynamic jar object using C.add with a specified scale and position
create_static_bar_with_C_add: create a static bar object using C.add and position it with set_left and set_bottom
create_dynamic_ball_with_C_add: create a dynamic ball object using C.add and position it relative to another body
update_task_with_spatial_relationship: call C.update_task to define the goal using body1, body2, and SpatialRelationship.INSIDE
